chapters.title: Chapter 546: Taking Velyra to The Tower [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Let’s just say the place I intend to take you guys is the most peaceful place in the entire universe. It’s my secret domain where only I have supreme authority over everything.
Nobody can enter or do anything in there without my permission. You all will live there for free and cultivate in peace.
If you want a place to train, I have many training grounds and even many powerful subordinates you can train with. It’s basically the best place for your people."
Kent answered the question, not hiding anything.
"Can a place like that really exist?" General Xant muttered.
"Trust me, it does exist. I’m even willing to take a representative there to confirm and see if it’s a place you want to stay in."
"Not that we don’t trust you. We do, but we don’t really know you. That’s why we are asking all these questions," Tribe Chief Malthar said, making Kent smile.
"I know, and I am not offended. However, I won’t lie just to get what I want." The elders nodded, understanding his words.
"Father, why don’t I go with him? I trust Kent, and I know he wouldn’t lie to us, so why don’t I go with him since this is a life-or-death decision for our people?"
"Are you sure?" Tribe Chief Malthar asked.
"Yes, Father." The tribe chief could only sigh.
"Take care of her, Kent," he said to the brat, who nodded.
"Don’t worry, Tribe Chief. We will be back in three days. I hope that is enough time for you to inform your people and get them ready for the move."
The tribe chief nodded. Kent then turned to Velyra.
"Let’s go meet your goddess; I’m sure she will be happy to see you." Velyra nodded and stood up. Kent followed, but instead of leaving right away, she asked to change first.

Kent had to wait for her to do that. A few minutes later, she came back dressed in a gown. However, instead of her usual baggy gown, she was clad in a rather tight gown that showed more skin than before.
Basically, she dressed to impress.
Not that Kent could blame her. She clearly wanted to appear more attractive.
"You don’t have to look at me like that. I just want to appear nicer before meeting the mother of killers," Velyra said with a smile and a slight blush.
"Since you want to dress to impress, why don’t we take care of the hair too?" Kent walked toward her and locked eyes with her.
Maintaining only a few inches of distance, he used his right hand to untie her ponytail, letting her hair fall behind her.
"Perfect," Kent said, making sure the tension didn’t rise too high before walking back. Velyra gulped, watching the dragon move away.
"Can we go now?" Kent asked, and she nodded.
He touched her hand, and the scenery changed around them the next second. They appeared in a lush garden with an air that immediately captivated Velyra’s attention.
"Welcome to my domain, Velyra. This is one of the many places inside my domain," Kent said, showing her the love garden.
Velyra’s expression was one of shock as she looked around, admiring the garden and the world around her. She just couldn’t believe such a world existed.
"Is this real?" she asked.
"This is one hundred percent real. It’s an isolated world that only I have access to—unless I grant you access," Kent answered.
"Why don’t I give you a tour first?" He didn’t want to take her to the city immediately, considering he needed her to get acquainted with her surroundings.
He also wanted to speak to the people living inside the city and ensure they were aware that a different race of beings would be joining them.
Kent took her hand and started showing her around.
"This is where I spend time with my wives," Kent said as they started walking.
"Wives? As in, you have more than one?" Velyra asked, looking at him in a certain way. She didn’t pay attention a few days ago when Kent made mention of his wives.
Now that she did, she became puzzled.
"Indeed. I have eleven wives and five lovers." She would know soon anyway, so it was better to make her aware now.
"Eleven wives and five lovers... That is—" She choked on her words, causing Kent to laugh.
"No need to look shocked. I have enough stamina to satisfy them all." Velyra blushed upon hearing that. She didn’t say it, but eleven wives sounded like a lot of work.
The only question on her mind now was whether the mother of killers was also one of his wives.
"Before you ask, yes, the mother of killers is one of my wives." Velyra came to a stop, looking at Kent with a calm expression.
"You’re not lying," she said, now visibly shocked.
"You’ll get used to it soon." They continued their tour for a few minutes before Kent led them in the direction of his ladies.
He had informed them he would be bringing someone over, so they should prepare. Thankfully, the time difference was enough for them to get ready, so they were already waiting for him.
However, when they appeared in the space, what greeted them was a group of lustful ladies dressed only in thin gowns, revealing practically all their assets.
"Kent!" Before he could say anything, Zaila jumped into his arms, locking lips with him. The other ladies had agreed she could have the moment, so they said nothing and simply watched her.
Meanwhile, Velyra, seeing these beautiful goddesses inside the tower, took a deep gulp and suddenly felt underdressed.
Kent broke the kiss but held Zaila in his arms, then looked toward his other ladies, who were now watching the red-skinned woman beside him.
"Everyone, this is Velyra. She is the priestess of the Bloodvein Tribe," Kent introduced the red-skinned beauty, who briefly felt overwhelmed.
However, a sense of familiarity washed over her when her gaze landed on Neomi. Instinctively, she dropped to her knees and bowed.
"I pay my respects to the Mother of Killers."
The ladies raised their brows upon hearing and watching this display.

However, I won’t lie just to get what I want." The elders nodded, understanding his words.
"Father, why don’t I go with him?
I trust Kent, and I know he wouldn’t lie to us, so why don’t I go with him since this is a life-or-death decision for our people?"
"Are you sure?" Tribe Chief Malthar asked.
"Yes, Father." The tribe chief could only sigh.
"Take care of her, Kent," he said to the brat, who nodded.
"Don’t worry, Tribe Chief.
We will be back in three days.
I hope that is enough time for you to inform your people and get them ready for the move."
The tribe chief nodded.
Kent then turned to Velyra.
"Let’s go meet your goddess; I’m sure she will be happy to see you." Velyra nodded and stood up.
Kent followed, but instead of leaving right away, she asked to change first.
Kent had to wait for her to do that.
A few minutes later, she came back dressed in a gown.
However, instead of her usual baggy gown, she was clad in a rather tight gown that showed more skin than before.
Basically, she dressed to impress.
Not that Kent could blame her.
She clearly wanted to appear more attractive.
"You don’t have to look at me like that.
I just want to appear nicer before meeting the mother of killers," Velyra said with a smile and a slight blush.
"Since you want to dress to impress, why don’t we take care of the hair too?" Kent walked toward her and locked eyes with her.
Maintaining only a few inches of distance, he used his right hand to untie her ponytail, letting her hair fall behind her.
"Perfect," Kent said, making sure the tension didn’t rise too high before walking back.
Velyra gulped, watching the dragon move away.
"Can we go now?" Kent asked, and she nodded.
He touched her hand, and the scenery changed around them the next second.
They appeared in a lush garden with an air that immediately captivated Velyra’s attention.
"Welcome to my domain, Velyra.
This is one of the many places inside my domain," Kent said, showing her the love garden.
Velyra’s expression was one of shock as she looked around, admiring the garden and the world around her.
She just couldn’t believe such a world existed.
"Is this real?" she asked.
"This is one hundred percent real.
It’s an isolated world that only I have access to—unless I grant you access," Kent answered.
"Why don’t I give you a tour first?" He didn’t want to take her to the city immediately, considering he needed her to get acquainted with her surroundings.
He also wanted to speak to the people living inside the city and ensure they were aware that a different race of beings would be joining them.
Kent took her hand and started showing her around.
"This is where I spend time with my wives," Kent said as they started walking.
"Wives?
As in, you have more than one?" Velyra asked, looking at him in a certain way.
She didn’t pay attention a few days ago when Kent made mention of his wives.
Now that she did, she became puzzled.
"Indeed.
I have eleven wives and five lovers." She would know soon anyway, so it was better to make her aware now.
"Eleven wives and five lovers...
That is—" She choked on her words, causing Kent to laugh.
"No need to look shocked.
I have enough stamina to satisfy them all." Velyra blushed upon hearing that.
She didn’t say it, but eleven wives sounded like a lot of work.
The only question on her mind now was whether the mother of killers was also one of his wives.
"Before you ask, yes, the mother of killers is one of my wives." Velyra came to a stop, looking at Kent with a calm expression.
"You’re not lying," she said, now visibly shocked.
"You’ll get used to it soon." They continued their tour for a few minutes before Kent led them in the direction of his ladies.
He had informed them he would be bringing someone over, so they should prepare.
Thankfully, the time difference was enough for them to get ready, so they were already waiting for him.
However, when they appeared in the space, what greeted them was a group of lustful ladies dressed only in thin gowns, revealing practically all their assets.
"Kent!" Before he could say anything, Zaila jumped into his arms, locking lips with him.
The other ladies had agreed she could have the moment, so they said nothing and simply watched her.
Meanwhile, Velyra, seeing these beautiful goddesses inside the tower, took a deep gulp and suddenly felt underdressed.
Kent broke the kiss but held Zaila in his arms, then looked toward his other ladies, who were now watching the red-skinned woman beside him.
"Everyone, this is Velyra.
She is the priestess of the Bloodvein Tribe," Kent introduced the red-skinned beauty, who briefly felt overwhelmed.
However, a sense of familiarity washed over her when her gaze landed on Neomi.
Instinctively, she dropped to her knees and bowed.
"I pay my respects to the Mother of Killers."
The ladies raised their brows upon hearing and watching this display.

chapters.title: Chapter 547: This Lady Is Exquisite [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So that is what it is," Neomi said, holding Velyra’s hand as she listened to what Kent said.
"Sister Neomi, it seems you were awesome in your past life," Unity said, making a fist bump. Her sisters nodded.
"So there is an entire race dedicated to my name?" Neomi asked, and Velyra nodded. Being touched by her god wasn’t something she expected. However, she had to come to terms with it and stop blushing.

"It’s only natural. I have many envoys out there that I don’t even know of. Many temples and cults teach my divinity, so it’s not surprising to have such a race worship you," Vexthra, the goddess, said.
"Does this mean there are others out there, too?" Neomi felt a heavy burden fall on her. It felt like she had to take on a role she wasn’t ready for.
"I know of Bloodvein tribes in the higher worlds. If the ones here are worshipping you, then it’s safe to say you have more fans in the upper heavens."
Neomi gulped.
Vexthra smiled. "You don’t have to worry. I am a goddess, remember?"
Neomi nodded, knowing she was just being silly. With her sister being a goddess, she could help her navigate this load.
"Wait, you are a goddess?" Velyra, however, was struck with yet another shocking discovery. She never expected there to be another goddess besides her goddess.
"Yes. Big sister is a big-time goddess. Though she walks among us mortals, she is someone with great power," Unity said, making Velyra want to bow to Vexthra, but she didn’t allow her.
"No need to do that. You are one of us now... isn’t that right, ladies?" The ladies nodded, smiling at Kent, who was kissing Zaila while paying attention to his wives.

Lady Vari and Elaine stood there, not knowing what to focus on—Kent kissing and massaging his soon-to-be wife, or the red-skinned lady who had just revealed that their god is the same lady they’ve been training with for the past months.
"Val, what are you doing?" Lilian suddenly asked, watching the rude saintess examine Velyra from head to toe, even going as far as lifting her gown from the back to see her ass.
When asked the question, she turned and looked at Kent.
"Husband, I have decided—I want to have red skin too. This lady is exquisite," Val said.
"You make it sound like she is a meal," Kent chuckled.

"Well, she will soon be a meal to you, but that is beside the point. I like her pigmentation." The ladies could only look at their sister, but after admiring Velyra for a moment, they couldn’t help but agree with what she said.

"Her skin is indeed exquisite; I wonder what she would taste like." Surprisingly, the ladies started moving closer to the red-skinned girl, who was both flustered and afraid of the crazy eyes looking at her.
"You ladies are scaring her," Kent said, causing them to halt in their steps—even Vexthra was part of it.
’Women are something else,’ Kent said inwardly before turning to Velyra...
"Don’t mind them, Velyra. I have spoiled them too much." Velyra smiled and held Neomi’s arm, ensuring she wouldn’t let go.
Vexthra smiled, watching the display.
"The moment you become a Demi-god, their faith in you will start coming in the form of divine essence. Trust me, you will understand how important having followers who believe in you is.
For now, do your best to connect with them and leave the rest for the future," Vexthra said, and Neomi nodded.
The goddess smiled.
She was clearly happy for her sister, making her wonder how many others of her sister had the same arrangement.

The events that happened during Zaila’s awakening made her question many things, and the only conclusion she could reach was that her sisters were reincarnations of powerful beings that once shook the universe.
This was the only conclusion she could reach. But until Kent confirmed it, she wouldn’t jump to an abrupt conclusion.

After a while, they all settled down on a large enough mat, eating fruits and pastries. Kent couldn’t help sighing. His ladies were practically nude, and he could see their little sister smiling at him.
He noticed Velyra was also aware of this but pretended she didn’t see anything. The only ones more composed and well-dressed were Lady Vari and Elaine.
Though he was sure they were also not wearing panties, considering how they were sitting.
"So you are planning on relocating them here?" Vexthra asked, sitting not far from him. She made sure her legs were positioned well for the dragon to fantasize about many things.
"Yes. Their land has been poisoned, and if I don’t move them to a more suitable place, they will go extinct in under a decade."
"Who would be this cruel to do such a thing?" Neomi asked with a frown. Not just her—her sisters were the same. They all wore the same angry expression.
"I’ve already dealt with the big guns; it’s just the main culprit that’s left," Kent said.
"Are you going to wait for him to appear? We want to join you. Please don’t say no," Unity said, wanting to see the one involved and deal them a heavy blow.
"Don’t worry, I plan on taking you all. But first, I will awaken your true names. Don’t worry, we have all the time in the world before their move into the tower," Kent said, and his wives smiled.
"So are you going to build a Blood Qi-rich city for them? Humans can’t sense Blood Qi or Chaos Qi.
So, allowing them to stay in the same place will cause mutation. However, their number is large, so will you build their own separate city?" Selene asked.

"Gaia always wanted to expand, so I will let her expand the city. Mixing with the humans will bring harmony, and since they will be living with them for as long as I am breathing, it’s good that we foster that unity from the start.
Different races will come in the future, so if they get acquainted now, transitions in the future will be easy. As for the mutation, provided it is good for them, I don’t mind.
But I will talk to the humans first after confirming with Gaia and her sisters."
"That is a great idea. Now we have more people to play with," Lilian giggled.
"I bet Gaia is going to bleed you dry," Vexthra joked, and her sisters laughed.
They continued to spend more time together. A while later, Kent prepared to go see the three lolis and talk to the city’s inhabitants.

chapters.title: Chapter 548: Spending Time With The Three Lolis [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Zaila dear, why don’t you wait for me on the bed? I’ll be back in a few hours," Kent said, kissing her in front of her sisters. Zaila, of course, wanted nothing more than to get what she was after.
It had been over a month since she woke up from the Nightmare Chamber, and aside from the need to tell Kent what went down inside, she first wanted to become his woman.

She had held onto this for the thousands of years she miraculously spent inside the Nightmare Chamber. So, hearing her turn was about to come, she immediately ran into the room, not minding her sisters.
Kent then looked at Nara and Lady Lani. "Your turn will come soon, so relax a little. A day at most." They nodded before he focused his attention on Elaine and Lady Vari.
"It looks like you two are blending in," Kent said with a smile, scanning their bodies from top to bottom. This gaze made the two ladies blush.
Kent just laughed. He knew they had fallen long ago, thanks to the shameless goddess currently smiling at him.
Vexthra used the corner of her eye to point in Velyra’s direction before licking her lips as she smiled at him. It was clear she meant nothing good.
"Velyra, I will be away for a few days. Make sure they don’t pollute you. And don’t worry—24 days here is just a day outside, so you have loads of time to spend with your goddess."
Kent waved them goodbye and left. The moment he was gone, Vexthra dropped her clothes and gestured for the ladies to go back to the Yin pool.
Naturally, they pulled the redskin beauty with them.
Kent appeared inside the mountain garden where the three lolis were resting in their mini-bikinis, sipping Mai Tais as they gazed over the city.
Kent couldn’t help but shake his head, watching the display. They were too small, so the setting just seemed funny.
He pictured Li Hua being with them, but unfortunately, the small human had fallen in love with meditation, so she wasn’t around much.
"Looks like you three don’t have anything to do. Why don’t I put you to work?" Kent said, walking toward them. They stood up and smiled at him.
⟪Master, you are back⟫, Gaia said, jumping into his arms. The other two weren’t far behind. Kent playfully fell back, making the three lolis giggle as they played with his hair.
"Since when did you three become jumpy?" Kent asked—not that he minded spending time with his three cosmic assistants.
⟪We just missed you. You don’t know that while it was just a week for you, it’s been months for us. And since we don’t have anything going on, we kinda missed you.
Plus, we already created the design for eight more Undeads, so play with us for a while⟫
Dori spoke like a spoiled child despite being millions of years old.

"Fine, we can play for two hours since I have a beauty waiting for me," Kent said, causing the three lolis to smirk. They knew their master was a spoiled honey bastard who couldn’t stay away from his ladies.
Not that they minded. They were the ones creating all the things for him and his ladies.
Kent, true to his word, spent the next two hours playing with them, which mostly involved wrestling.
Knowing they were basically children and couldn’t use their full strength lest they risk destroying the tower, he made himself weak, allowing them to win all the rounds.
Surprisingly, they were very happy whenever they won a match. Kent just let them be happy for the two-hour duration.
⟪Thanks for spending time with us, Master. I will create a unique skill for you when I have time⟫ Akira said with a smile.
⟪I will allow you to pick one item from the Gaia Store. Know that this is a separate store with only my personal collection⟫, Gaia also said.
Dori just smiled.
⟪I don’t have anything material to give you, but I know a place where you can go to get something valuable. When you have time, I’ll take you there⟫
Kent nodded.
Meanwhile, far at the core of the universe, the lady watching every second of Kent’s life play out smiled and spoke,
"Are you sure you want to give it to him that easily? I could have sworn you said you wouldn’t allow him to have it until he fulfills the promise he made to you billions of years ago."
⟪I guess he’s growing on me. Plus, since I made it for him, he can have it now. It doesn’t change anything⟫
"I hope you’re right. This brat tends to forget things easily," the lady said again.
⟪I am his mind, so I’ll remind him—even if it takes millions of years⟫
"You really—... Ah, forget about it. Do as you please. I’ll remain here, watching everything play out."
⟪Don’t worry, Mother. He will notice you soon enough, and knowing him, he’ll find his way to you⟫. Dori smiled, watching Kent pinch Gaia’s nose.
"I will surely wait for that day to come," she smiled.
⟪Of course, if you’re too hungry to wait, you can always create a clone to hunt him down and get what you want. I know you can easily do that. After all, you are the universe⟫
"Go away, Doriana. I’m done talking to you." The lady blushed at Dori’s cheeky words. However, a wave of determination appeared in her eyes.
"I might just take her idea if he doesn’t find me soon." A smile that would shatter planets and destroy galaxies appeared on her lips.
Far in a world nobody dares step into, inside a temple no one dares enter, a beauty whose hair falls down her back, touching the floor, smiles for some reason.
She is the Ancient Enchantress, a being born on the same day the universe came into existence.
"What a slut," she muttered, causing a new voice to echo through her temple.
"As if you are any different," the enchantress smirked.

chapters.title: Chapter 549: A huge Project [Bonus]
paragraphs: Kent ensured all playing with the three lolis was out of the way before getting down to business.
⟪So that was the mission you went on. I wonder why the Tower was so secretive about it,⟫ Gaia said after Kent narrated everything he had been up to after he was teleported to the Dead Region.
It turned out even the three cosmic beings had no idea what quest he had embarked on.
"Yes. So they need a place to stay for the rest of their lives—unless, of course, they one day want to leave. But for now, I want you three to expand the city. You have 72 days tops for that."
The three ladies looked at each other’s faces, and a smile appeared on them.
⟪We can do what you require of us. In fact, we will make it even better by ensuring they are comfortable, have very strong blood qi to enrich their bloodline, and even make the chaos qi more dense.

Aside from that, Dori here happens to have met the Bloodvein Tribe before, so we can even create an ancestral land where they can go and comprehend some techniques that can be found only in Dori’s collection.
We can basically make them powerful and allow them to live comfortable lives. However, it is going to cost you,⟫ Dori said, raising her pinky finger.
"How much are we talking?" Kent asked, knowing this was something he expected.
⟪Some unexpected and minor technicalities might come in, but for now, we are tracking 80 million Tower Points, and that includes everything.⟫
Kent did a quick check of his Tower Points.
⟦Tower Points: 120,000,000⟧
’Looks like Kaizo and the team had done some heavy lifting for me,’ Kent smiled.
"Very well." Kent accepted the offer. "So, how long would it take before you get it done?"
